briefTitle: Study to Test the Safety and Tolerability of PF-07220060 in Participants With Advance Solid Tumors

typedChecks.sourceText: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status (PS) 0 or 1
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status (PS) 0 or 1

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: NSCLC (Non-small Cell Lung Cancer)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: The trial is a basket study for multiple advanced solid tumors including NSCLC, with specific criteria varying heavily by study part.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: At least 1 line of SOC, including CD4/6 inhibitor therapy for advanced or metastatic disease, or if CDK4/6 inhibitors are not considered appropriate in the opinion of the investigator
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior therapy and lines requirements differ completely depending on the specific study part and cancer type.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Adequate renal, liver, and bone marrow function
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Organ function is qualitative without explicit numeric cutoff values in this section.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known active uncontrolled or symptomatic Central Nervous System (CNS) metastases carcinomatous meningitis, or leptomeningeal disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Active, uncontrolled, and symptomatic CNS metastases are subjective modifiers and not a simple typed brain_mets rule.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Other active malignancy within 3 years prior to randomization, except for adequately treated basal cell or squamous cell skin cancer, or carcinoma in situ
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior active malignancy exclusions are complex and not covered by typed criteria.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Major surgery or radiation within 4 weeks prior to study intervention
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout windows for surgery and radiation are not typed check kinds.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Minimum Age: 18 Years
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: evidence quote was not a verbatim substring of the trial text

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: NSCLC (Non-small Cell Lung Cancer)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: The trial admits multiple advanced solid tumors with cohort-specific rules rather than a single unified stage or histology list for NSCLC.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Tumors other than BC (Parts 1A/1D/1E/1F): tumor that is resistant to at least 2 lines of SOC for advanced or recurrent disease or for which no standard therapy is available
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior-line and treatment requirements vary widely by study part and cohort.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known active uncontrolled or symptomatic Central Nervous System (CNS) metastases carcinomatous meningitis, or leptomeningeal disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: The wording covers active, uncontrolled, or symptomatic CNS disease, which is not a clean typed brain_mets status.
